factories.name: settings_read
factories.requires: Parent lease and actual retained spend policy with unavailable writer; no availability simulation or mode change. Distinct admin/settings_operator/read_operator subjects, real allowed/denied settings reads and compiled cookie UI. One local browser GET is transport-aborted; its receipt has no server status/AM, subsequent real recovery response is retained, and both AMs are read. Parent disposal owns immutable read audits.

factories.name: settings_conflict
factories.requires: Parent settings lease; disabled autonomous policies and actual compatible budget writers; two compiled cookie browser sessions. Local-proxy fault forwards one PUT without retries/redirects, withholds only an observed 2xx response and retains subsequent dispatches/errors through cleanup. Distinct disabled owner-policy drafts are input data; case owns public writes/restoration, parent owns database disposal.

factories.name: automatic_pause
factories.requires: Real idle, busy and Always-on Sandboxes; waitIdleThreshold records actual elapsed time and grace; public revival cleanup.

factories.name: measured_visibility
factories.requires: Completed personal/admin reports with allocations and a real missing measurement gap; compiled UI roles.

factories.name: settings_retention
factories.requires: Public settings read plus parent-held settings lease and real compiled UI. Built-in factory supplied.

factories.name: user_limit
factories.requires: Concrete parent-bound createUserLimitFactory({userResources}) recipe supplied; parent still binds a genuinely empty disposable user for each repetition, distinct admin/user subjects, pinned profile, subordinate resource custody with retainRefusal, disabled background policies and independent native finality. Three unique public intents are retained before dispatch; accepted and typed-refusal receipts resolve original intents, unknown outcomes never replay. Settings lease is already held; do not nest it.

factories.name: visitor_limits
factories.requires: Exact unprivileged visitor, separate Sandbox/daily-launch boundary intents and public inventory; quota cleanup.

factories.name: trigger_settings
factories.requires: Disposable pending trigger occurrence, bounded waitDispatchBoundary and raw readLaunches; no launch-result oracle.

factories.name: idle_preview
factories.requires: Exclusive scanner cohort idle/busy/Always-on, actual lifecycle/event reads with no spontaneous maintenance.

factories.name: idle_pause
factories.requires: Idle/busy/Always-on cohort; readBusyWork returns sequence and restarts; public revival and provider cleanup.

factories.name: defaults_marketplace
factories.requires: Concrete parent-bound createDefaultsMarketplaceFactory supplies public-created/published agent/workspace/sandbox profiles, default-dependent POST conversations with no overrides and exact revision readback. Bind empty disposable user/admin roles, actual defaultsCapacity, subordinate userResources custody/native finality and parent settings lease. Invalid and unpublished references remain refusal assertions; erroneous acceptance fails and restores defaults. Profiles retire before settings-lease release; no create replay or automatic readiness.

factories.name: settings_patch
factories.requires: Exact image source with hashed reset contract; archived coordinator requires absolute config.admin_source_repository with that Git commit; disabled autonomous policies and compatible spend writers; public-created/published alternate Agent profile, eight changed sections, reset audit, restore then retire; parent disposal required.

factories.name: settings_audit
factories.requires: Parent global lease; exact admin/settings_operator subjects and cookie roles; disabled background policies; open writable admission. Real retention patch then 25 stop/resume pairs displace its audit without changing settings; unknown writes never replay; public restoration and parent disposal required.

factories.name: spend_availability
factories.requires: Real enabled/unavailable writer configurations via parent-owned fixture modes; retained policy with writable baseline.

factories.name: spend_period
factories.requires: Public settings read verifies actual spend writer; source-valid synthetic period plus invalid ordering, RFC3339 and exact-integer inputs. Parent lease and compiled UI required.

factories.name: default_owner_policy
factories.requires: Real owners with/without override, existing reservations; admitModelRequest and readReservations expose raw local receipts.

factories.name: owner_overrides
factories.requires: Distinct owner and changed policies, concurrent server policy, 1024 valid overrides, actual admission receipt.

factories.name: request_models
factories.requires: Valued/unvalued/unlisted model names, real admission/provider counters, real request-writer-unavailable mode.

factories.name: activity_table
factories.requires: At least51 immutable matching audit rows and known actor/action labels; first page includes success/refusal/failure and missing names.

factories.name: activity_full
factories.requires: Known configure AND delete records, exact request receipts, actor filter and failed activity read seam.

factories.name: admission_read
factories.requires: At least21 public-created transitions, actual write-unavailable configuration under parent control.

factories.name: admission_change
factories.requires: Initially open admission, live ongoing turn, unique fresh creates, custody, withheld resume response and raw dispatch receipt.

factories.name: trigger_commands
factories.requires: Exclusive settings lease; pending occurrence and raw launch/audit reads with real dispatch boundary.

factories.name: spend_read
factories.requires: Actual enabled/disabled/dependency-unavailable/no-cloud modes and exact local accounting inputs.

factories.name: spend_observation
factories.requires: Isolated cloud ledger, positive safe units/time and real unavailable writer mode.

factories.name: cross_owner_reads
factories.requires: Concrete parent-bound createCrossOwnerReadFactory(bindings) uses existing public resource hierarchy, real completed marker turn and file write/readback. Bind userResources, identities.user, explicit same-subject user/creator roles, distinct read_operator/outsider roles and real compiled cookie UI. Parent native finality owns root cleanup; no fixture output oracle or automatic readiness.

factories.name: cross_owner_interaction
factories.requires: Control operator, real long turn with initial output then interrupt, second approval turn, revocation barrier and provider counters.

factories.name: cross_owner_controls
factories.requires: Concrete parent-bound createCrossOwnerControlsFactory uses public resource hierarchy, live capabilities and authenticated compiled cookie sessions to distinguish control-only from control+use-own. Bind userResources, compiledWeb, identities.user/control_user/control_operator and matching exact role subjects; distinct creator/control/read principals. Idle prompt-capable Agent and unique control inputs are read/generated. All restoration attempts memoize failures, root public/native finality owns attachment cleanup. Existing control-only preference GET denial remains a case assertion despite current source mismatch.

factories.name: sandbox_commands
factories.requires: Active disposable Sandbox, resource credentials, queue hold/expiry and access-revocation barriers; native lifecycle counters.

factories.name: operator_recovery
factories.requires: Failed never-ready worktree and failed Workspace through public setup; retained home marker and valid original recovery keys.

factories.name: operator_custody
factories.requires: Operator versus creator identities, documented sharing/service/bridge/profile operations with exact source-derived denials [{status,code}], before/after public-state reads and positive owner control. Generic route 404 cannot qualify; current bridge-management mutation binding remains required, not replaced by read-only channel history.

factories.name: organization_inventory
factories.requires: Real admin/member/viewer organization memberships, organization-owned Agent/Sandbox hierarchy and membership revocation.

factories.name: organization_interaction
factories.requires: Org interaction fixture plus narrow-Agent and whole-Sandbox shares, files/settings and raw provider effect counters.

factories.name: organization_sharing
factories.requires: Personal-owner share target, org-owned denied target, original keys, recipient revocation and withheld revoke acknowledgement.

factories.name: link_service_boundary
factories.requires: Compiled creator/recipient UI, separate pending service requests, synthetic connected services, scope reads with no credential values.

factories.name: organization_lifecycle
factories.requires: Disposable org-owned Sandbox and separate live org_roles recipient target; public receipts and provider finality reads.

factories.name: organization_history
factories.requires: Current bridge capability, known history/artifact digests, supported share control and read-in-flight revocation barrier.
